messages.en:
Your letter came today.
Nothing's changed, right?

Thanks for the letter. It
smelled dreamy...

I was so hungry that I
ate your letter!

I wish I could write cool 
letters like you.

I was taking a bath when
your letter arrived.

Your letter smelled nice.
Were you picking flowers?

I'm writing you a response
right away. I'm good, huh?

I'm writing before dinner,
and I'm just starving.

You're just a big softie!
Not me, though!

That letter was pretty
deep. You're a thinker.

I couldn't wait for your
letter to come. I {00 00 00} mail!

It's finally here! I was
waiting for it, you know.

Your letters inspire me.
So does candy.

I thought your letter
would get here sooner.

I liked your letter so
much that I've saved it.

That blotch on the paper?
It's not drool, OK?

Thanks for everything.
I'm so full...

Sorry for my handwriting.
My hand was asleep!

I was writing you when a
wave of snackiness hit!

I'm writing this in the
bathroom. Neat, huh!
